reference.title: List of Approved AI Tools at NC State
reference.shortdesc: This list contains approved AI tools that can be used at NC State.

strow.stentry: Generative AI chatbot that is available at no cost to students, faculty, and staff. Log in at gemini.google.com using your NC State account.
Google AI Pro for Education is available to faculty, staff, and departments with a paid Google Enterprise license. To purchase a license, visit software.ncsu.edu.
This tool helps organize and refine your ideas by analyzing documents and providing summaries, explanations, and suggestions. Available to students, faculty, and staff at notebooklm.google.com.
Allows you to create videos. Available to students, faculty, and staff at vids.google.com.
Microsoft’s generative AI chatbot, is available at no cost to students, faculty, and staff by logging in to Microsoft 365 with your NC State account.
Available to faculty, staff, and departments with a paid Microsoft 365 license. Includes integration with other Microsoft 365 products, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

Formerly ChatGPT Team, this tool is approved for use by faculty, staff, and departments. Uses GPT-4o and includes access to additional features like DALL-E, browsing and advanced data analysis. Purchase a license at chatgpt.com/business.
Approved for use by faculty, staff, and departments. Purchase a license at grammarly.com/pro.

Provides a suite of features that use large-language models to provide interpretive services for a Zoom meeting, such as capturing highlights of important information discussed during the meeting or providing "next steps" based on the discussion at the end of a meeting.
